outcome: symptoms of postpartum posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
cohort: A total of 168 women from a French-speaking sample participated in this study, with assessments at immediate postpartum, 2 months postpartum, and 6 months postpartum.
finding: 11.7% of participants reported symptoms of PTSD 2 months after birth, and 10.5% at 6 months, with peritraumatic distress, negative perceived childbirth experience, and complications/difficulties during birth identified as predictive factors.
